poses.caption: Lie supine with bent knees tilted together to one side and hands lightly behind the head.
Curl the shoulders upward, squeeze the side of the waist, then lower slowly; finish repetitions and switch sides.

jobs.detail: SUPINE SIDE CRUNCH WITH KNEES TILTED, TWO equal SQUARE panels side by side SAME high front three-quarter camera showing torso and both legs, head IMAGE LEFT feet RIGHT. Lie on BACK on thin gray mat, pelvis grounded, BOTH knees bent about90degrees and TILTED TOGETHER toward model LEFT side, knees/feet rest sideways near floor in same fixed positions BOTH phases. Upper back/chest faces ceiling, not lying fully on side. BOTH hands lightly behind head/ears elbows open, no neck pulling. LEFT lower: shoulder blades/upper back resting MAT, head aligned neutral. RIGHT crunch: gently curl upper back/shoulder blades UP toward ceiling about15cm, chest/face remains ceiling, ribs approach pelvis, head follows torso neck neutral, BOTH elbows remain open, hands light. Knees stay tilted and grounded; neither legs nor feet lift, pelvis fixed, no bicycle/sideplank/twisting movement between poses. Primary abdominal red only ONE smooth diffuse BLURRED tint over side/front intact BLACK shirt, broad cloth folds only no fibers/rays. Fine exposed grayscale arms/calves. Opaque clothing fully wraps seat/crotch, full model within margins.

poses.caption: Take a wide stance, bend one knee and shift the hips back while keeping the other leg straight and chest up. Hold 20–30 seconds, then switch sides.

jobs.detail: SIDE LUNGE ADDUCTOR STRETCH, ONE static full-body hold FRONT three-quarter view. Wide stance, toes generally forward. Shift body/pelvis to IMAGE LEFT over deeply bent LEFT knee, left knee tracks left shoe, heel flat. RIGHT leg extends sideways to IMAGE RIGHT with knee STRAIGHT and right shoe flat floor, both heels stay down. Hips back/down, chest UP long neutral spine, head neutral, no twisting. Both hands rest lightly on bent left thigh above knee for balance, no pushing joint, no equipment. Primary ADDUCTORS of STRAIGHT RIGHT LEG ONE soft diffuse BLURRED red patch over INNER UPPER THIGH on fully opaque BLACK shorts near inner seam, not outer hip, no red kneecap/calf. No muscle rays/fibers/anatomical divisions on cloth, broad natural seams/folds only. Fine grayscale exposed arms/calves. Full shirt/shorts wraps front sides rear seat crotch, no fabric opening or cutaway. Entire body shoes/hands/head within generous white margins.
